# vendor

Pieces copied from other LITSA projects so the site builds on its own:

- `identity/`: the LITSA wordmark and torch geometry (`glyphs.py`, `torch.py`, `emit.py`, `variants.py`) and
  the torch master SVG. The site draws its logo from these.
- `domains.py`: the field taxonomy behind the field guide pages.

Edit the site's look in `src/` and `static/`; change these only to update the logo or the taxonomy.
